definition.given: The user is signed in with Profile settings open and the current black-sand cover displayed. Cover image 3, showing star trails, is available in the cover picker.
definition.when: The user selects the star-trails cover, clicks Save changes, then closes Profile settings and reopens Settings from the avatar menu in the same session.
definition.observed: Saving the star-trails cover reports Profile updated successfully, but closing and reopening Profile settings shows the previous black-sand cover.
definition.require: Reopening Profile settings in the same session displays the star-trail cover just confirmed as saved, using the latest committed choice without a full-page refresh.
allow: Reentry may refetch server data, update caches, or reuse the latest confirmed state.
A brief loading indicator or skeleton may appear while the latest cover loads. Content presented as the current saved cover reflects the latest confirmed choice.
On save failure, the old cover may remain with explicit failure feedback.

theory.title: Action lifecycle and immediate feedback - Success responses must agree with the subsequently visible committed state
theory.reference: Designing Interfaces, Third Edition, Chapter 8: Actions and Commands; designing-interfaces/chapters/ch08-actions.md
theory.rationale: Save changes, the success message, and reopening settings form a complete conversation. Success should mean that the new cover is authoritative. Showing the old value upon return falsifies the feedback and forces users to guess whether saving succeeded.

theory.title: Preserve orientation and state - Returning to a familiar interface should preserve meaningful current state
theory.reference: Designing Interfaces, Third Edition, Chapter 3: Navigation, Signposts, and Wayfinding; designing-interfaces/chapters/ch03-navigation-wayfinding.md
theory.rationale: Closing and reopening settings is short-distance navigation and should not lose a just-confirmed profile state. Displaying the same saved cover on reentry maintains a continuous understanding of the user's position and the system state.

reference_observation: After the star-trails cover is saved successfully, closing and reopening Profile settings shows the same cover without a browser refresh.
requirement_rationale: Save confirmation tells the user that their profile choice has been committed. Showing that cover when settings reopen lets the user rely on the confirmation across navigation.
